entries.back_en: "We need to pass through Chamba. Is there any way to do that before the hex disappears?"

"Have you heard? They say there's some kind of fish monster or something living deep in the city!" "Yes, I've heard about it. What do you expect? That hex affects anything it touches— I bet there's all kinds of strange stuff in there!"
"I always knew you were a strange guy... Makes sense you'd take this job!"
"I'm not working with the vigor I used to... I just don't have energy anymore. Must be the hex... Yes, that's it—it's gotta be the hex!"
"This hex is pretty potent... Never seen one like it. I mean, we cleaned up Synesta in an instant!"
